## Requirements (from the contract)

1. `sig.statement/1` per-compartment statements files —
   `record_claims` published into the release tree per compartment,
   manifest entry, compartment-licence split honoured (ODbL claims
   never in a CC-BY file).
2. `upstream_href` filled through the P35.31 S-6 gate — full URL
   only for raw-ok/derived-only lanes past the publication gate,
   host + path hash otherwise, `no_upstream_url_recorded` when
   absent, `not_publishable` when the host itself cannot publish.
3. One `<ProvenancePanel>` data contract + component — J3 §5.1's
   four binding-state wordings verbatim (`legacy_synthetic` renders
   the run-level sentence, never a per-record document), rendered
   identically on record pages, relationship rows, edge panels, the
   map selection panel and the claim viewer.
4. `#claim-<id>` anchors; every panel field a value or a named
   absence kind; no state implies a capture/document SIG does not
   hold.
5. Tests: schema per compartment, S-6 cases, verbatim binding
   wording, ODbL separation, cross-surface render check.
6. Stamps: `SIG-TRANSP-011` (owner) + cited ids
   (SIG-TRANSP-012/022/025, SIG-UI-028, SIG-UI-035).

## Design reconciliation notes (recorded, not improvised)

- J3 §3's artifact table names `statements.parquet`/`csv.gz`;
  this export pipeline's per-compartment table convention is
  JSONL (`record_claims.jsonl`, `labels/<comp>.jsonl`), so the
  statements artifact lands as `<comp>/statements.jsonl` — the
  same stream the design assigns, in the pipeline's own serialiser.
- `sig.statement/1` rows are a **superset** of the
  `record_claims` row (same anchor fields plus the provenance
  block the panel reads); `record_claims.jsonl` keeps emitting
  unchanged — the statements file is additive, the release's
  `_claim_index` prefers it and falls back to `record_claims`
  for pre-P35.36 exports.
- Raw claim values are never emitted: `value` carries the closed
  token `not_published` (the record_claims contract already refuses
  raw literals; statements inherit that rule).
- The claim viewer (`/evidence/<claim>/`, SIG-UI-028) is emitted
  only where `actual_capture` bindings exist on document genres —
  J3 §5.2's cap is TX-08b's machinery; this row's viewer surfaces
  the panel through the same contract where claim views exist
  (fixtures today).
